description.fallback: Ada wakes up and ignores Code when he greets her, prompting him to threaten to cut her throat. Ada remained unconcerned and told Code to try as the latter is incapable of performing the act. As Ada is worried about her bad breath, she has the two wait at the compound's bar while she brushes her teeth.
